summary: Attempted to verify /finance route. Frontend fails to compile due to JSX syntax errors in FinanceLandingPage.jsx. Webpack overlay 'Compiled with problems' displayed instead of the page. Main agent's claim that tags are aligned is INCORRECT — the file contains many self-closing SVG elements (path, polyline, circle, rect, line) that are IMMEDIATELY followed by an explicit closing tag (e.g., '<path ... /></path>', '<circle ... /></circle>', '<polyline ... /></polyline>', '<rect ... /></rect>', '<line ... /></line>'). Babel reports: 'Expected corresponding JSX closing tag for <svg>. (115:1424)' and later 'Unterminated JSX contents. (153:10)'.

failed.evidence: PAGE ERROR: Module build failed ... SyntaxError: /app/frontend/src/pages/FinanceLandingPage.jsx: Expected corresponding JSX closing tag for <svg>. (115:1424). Second run: 'Unterminated JSX contents. (153:10)'. Screenshot shows 'Compiled with problems:' overlay.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/FinanceLandingPage.jsx, remove the stray extra closing tags after every self-closing SVG child. Specifically delete the trailing </path>, </polyline>, </circle>, </rect>, </line> that immediately follow a `<tag ... />` self-closing form. Example patterns to fix: '<path ... /></path>' -> '<path ... />', '<polyline ... /></polyline>' -> '<polyline ... />', '<circle ... /></circle>' -> '<circle ... />', '<rect ... /></rect>' -> '<rect ... />', '<line ... /></line>' -> '<line ... />'. Do this across the whole file (many occurrences in the 'THE PROOF' cards, the growth-engine SVG around line ~115, and the 'Identifying Fit' icon cards). Also verify the final outer </svg> at ~line 153 is correctly matched after cleanup.
After fix, reload /finance and confirm H1 'Nobody moves their money because of an ad.' renders and no webpack overlay is present.
